At the moment that everyone is talking about switching models often for cost or sovereignty or optionality or whatever, the most advanced models are growing more and more different from each other. Fable responds very differently than Kimi K3 or Sol, you can't just plug & play
This makes complete sense, as models do longer and longer tasks that require more and more judgement decisions that add up, small differences in models result in very different kinds of outcomes.
